meta.status: revision-stage exploratory analysis, written before running

A1_leave_one_vault_out.note: Each distinct vault key (cluster*100000+vault_raw) removed from all periods of the group; placebo means of the full run held fixed (not re-estimated).

A2_subgroups.note: R intervals of cells with fewer than 10 near or far events are flagged (ci_unreliable_...): resamples with no far event make the upper bound explode. Subgroup placebo means computed on the subgroup's vaults (and, for capacity class, on index failures placed in servers of that class), as in dd_unified_analyse.sub_est; vault bootstrap with placebo mean fixed. Rows with zero far or near events give undefined R.

A3_service_visit.note: Placebo means from the full-window base run (sets d1, d4, window 1-30) applied to every part. Rrep from dd_v10_clock.lr; Srv = first new drive in the index server after the index drive's last located day.

A4_early_life.age_definition: age at failure = poh0/24 (power-on hours at first appearance in the period) + calendar days from first record to failure record F; days since first record in the period reported as well (left-censored at period start).

A5_absolute.note: Excess per 1,000 index failures = 1000*(O - E*placebo_mean)/n_index; n_index = index failures whose window starts inside the period. A follow-on failure is counted once for every index window that contains it (and for every index in its server), so these are event-clustering counts, not distinct drives.

10061.rule: failure date <= period end - 30 (complete 30-day window), all failures of drives with a slot number (dd_review2 FULL filter; dd_unified_analyse n_index_full)

10060.rule: same complete-window failures but only those with a located daily record on or before the failure date (dd_v7_lags.py); 2024 has one failing drive with no located record before its failure

705_706.source: dd_v7_cohort.load (REPL=1, GAPI=14, GAPE=14, ANCHOR=fdate) re-run on runs_k2026 / k2026c

iii_drive_days.sources: rows/loc_days: results/dd_idcheck_rekeyc_2.json (2024-2026H1) and results/dd_review2_pc_master.txt line 2 (2023H2 full-period idcheck output); drive-days with slot: results/v6runs/runs_k*.json rows
iii_drive_days.reading: 333.7 M = all daily rows with a server (vault, pod) location; 329.0 M = drive-days with a slot number (location-days 328,978,216; drive-days 328,978,223; the difference of 7 is the seven 2025 location-days with two drives).

iv_drive_snapshot_metric.note: capture = share of positive test rows (drive-days followed by a failure) inside the top-ranked budget share of rows

v_random_tie_order.key_names: s0 = baseline score M0, s1 = neighbour model M1; c<k> = cool-down of k weekly scans (c0 = original rule); row_order = ties broken by row order (Supplementary Table 8); tie_random = 20 random tie orders (c0 and the primary M0 cool-down c1 only)

vi_original_key_columns.finding: No result file in results/ or rerun_check/ holds the Supplementary Table 2 original-key values (explore H1 1.21 (1.14-1.29), H4 1.89 (1.59-2.24); 2026H1 H1 1.28 (1.13-1.45), H4 1.90 (1.37-2.58)). They come from the original frozen run of 2026-10-14, whose output files (dd_confirm_2026.json, dd_batch_diag_2026.json) were not archived. The only archived original-key frozen-script output is results/rerun_check/dd_confirm_origkey_2026-10-19.json (2026H1 only, current tables).
